tests.name: Test 1.1 - Contact field prompt comes from the system catalog

rows.action: Start a booking flow that asks for contact details.
rows.what_is_tested: The backend resolves the field prompt from the system message catalog.
The reply appears correct and is not coming from a hard-coded backend literal path.

tests.name: Test 1.2 - Validation retry uses the catalog

rows.action: Enter an invalid phone or email value.
rows.what_is_tested: The backend reaches the retry-validation path.
The retry message comes from the system message catalog and matches the active locale.

tests.name: Test 2.1 - Lost-slot conflict uses the catalog

rows.action: Trigger a scheduling conflict such as a lost selected slot.
rows.what_is_tested: The backend reaches a conflict-message path.
The conflict message comes from the system message catalog rather than hard-coded backend text.

tests.name: Test 3.1 - Locale switch changes system messages without code changes

rows.action: Switch to another configured locale if supported in scope.
rows.what_is_tested: Locale resolution changes the message source file.

rows.action: Re-run a booking or conflict state already covered above.
rows.what_is_tested: The same backend state returns the translated system message.

tests.name: Test 3.2 - Tenant conversational content remains outside the system catalog

rows.action: Review tenant-driven replies such as greetings, services, or business overview.
rows.what_is_tested: Tenant profile content ownership remains unchanged.

rows.action: Compare those replies with system workflow messages.
rows.what_is_tested: System messages come from the new catalog while tenant conversational content still comes from tenant profile behavior.
